# Khronos OpenCL headers

Three unmodified headers from [Khronos OpenCL-Headers](https://github.com/KhronosGroup/OpenCL-Headers/tree/e6060189f4ebe8b52d885c37af71b9a50c272154), revision `e6060189f4ebe8b52d885c37af71b9a50c272154`.

Licensed under Apache-2.0, compatible with q3mapx GPL-3.0-or-later. See LICENSE.
The runtime loader is optional and supplied by the GPU driver. No driver binaries are included.
